scope.media: Stored extractions and transcripts are supplied fixtures; OCR, transcription and real transport are not evaluated.

changes: Internal content bindings persist through clarification, restart and retry.
Whole messages or explicitly selected text/attachment parts are copied exactly.
Missing internal selection is recoverable without asking users for IDs.

initialFailures.receiptFailure: Synthetic employee profiles contained email and active fields. A spread copied these into a strict delivery receipt, causing serialization to fail. Production wiring already projects these fields; the receipt boundary is now robust independently.
initialFailures.voiceFixture: Corrected seeded transcript marker from textOrigin to the persisted voiceTranscript contract.

limitations: A single corpus execution plus focused retest is a smoke evaluation, not a reliability or pass@k estimate.
Choosing the intended brief, target, scope and optional enrichment remains model judgment.
The complete corpus preceded the final pending-media guidance and multiple-binding ambiguity refinement; final deterministic tests cover both, with a paid pending-media retest.
The final waiting-turn retest needed an internal review repair to retrieve the source before answering; initial model source selection remains fallible. Its delivered answer passed verification.
accounting: Conservative estimated model charges including failed attempts and focused retests; every reservation settled. This is not a provider invoice.

deterministicCoverage: Explicit whole/part copying and no fallback to confirmation text

Later corrected full brief supersedes unfinished selection
Persisted source selection survives restart and quoted older-source follow-up
Completed operation reuse and multiple-action ambiguity do not create extra writes
